simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָעֵף (H3287) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָעֵף (yâʻêph) means fatigued ; figuratively, exhausted First listed occurrence: 2Sam 16 2.

definitions.full: H3287. yaeph יָעֵף adjective weary, faint ; — always as substantive, except Judg 8:15 הַיְּפֵעִים אנשׁיך (of physical fatigue from lack of bread); הַיָּעֵף 2Sam 16:2 (from lack of drink); of mind and spirit Isa 40:29 (|| אוֺנִין אֵין ), 50:4 .
